title: When the Letter Turns
author: August Blackwood
blurb: August Reyes, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
